g.text: 1. Function: BQ28Z610-R1 reads both cells (VC2 after the fuse, VC1 on the tap) and counts charge

g.desc: 1. Function: BQ28Z610-R1 reads both cells (VC2 after the fuse, VC1 on the tap) and counts charge

g.text: on a 3 mΩ low-side sense resistor; the pack PCM protects and balances (ADR 0014, ADR 0017).

g.desc: on a 3 mΩ low-side sense resistor; the pack PCM protects and balances (ADR 0014, ADR 0017).

g.text: 2. Absent state: never omitted. Storage: Blackbird OS sends MAC 0x0010 twice, then the BQ25798

g.desc: 2. Absent state: never omitted. Storage: Blackbird OS sends MAC 0x0010 twice, then the BQ25798

g.text: enters shutdown mode; the ship FET opens, PACK falls and the gauge shuts down (ADR 0017 item 3).

g.desc: enters shutdown mode; the ship FET opens, PACK falls and the gauge shuts down (ADR 0017 item 3).

g.text: 3. VSS, PWPD and every gauge capacitor return to BAT_N, the cell side of the sense resistor;

g.desc: 3. VSS, PWPD and every gauge capacitor return to BAT_N, the cell side of the sense resistor;

g.text: SRP to the cell side, SRN to GND, each through 100 Ω, 100 nF at the pins (SLUSE07B Figure 9-1).

g.desc: SRP to the cell side, SRN to GND, each through 100 Ω, 100 nF at the pins (SLUSE07B Figure 9-1).

g.text: 4. CHG and DSG open (no FETs: SLUSE07B §8.3.14; TI E2E 903283, forum guidance).

g.desc: 4. CHG and DSG open (no FETs: SLUSE07B §8.3.14; TI E2E 903283, forum guidance).

g.text: 5. TS1: board NTC NCP15XH103F03RC against the pocket floor (BOM v1 line 48).
